  "for user mholt across all Engineering subspaces\u201d) show that the access occurred and succeeded but do "
  "not show what the permissions were; Complaint \u00b6\u00b6 40, 93 and 106 supply SkyVault's assertion that it "
  "limited access to authorized personnel.",
  "Tests whether the accesses SkyVault now characterizes as out-of-scope were in fact permitted by "
  "SkyVault's own configuration \u2014 which bears both on the \u201cimproper means\u201d element and on the "
  "reasonableness of SkyVault's secrecy measures. The permissions-audit result (Row #\u00a041) is not in our "
  "file and must be requested."),

q("H-3", "What was your understanding of SkyVault's rules on downloading files to your workstation and on "
         "connecting removable media, and how were those rules communicated and enforced while you were "
         "there?",
  "ECIAA \u00a7\u00a7 4.1\u20134.3 state the contractual rules (no transfer of Company data to personal devices "
  "without prior written authorization; no connection of personal storage devices without prior written "
  "approval of the supervisor or IT; consent to monitoring); Exhibit F Row #\u00a039 Notes reference a separate "
  "\u201cSkyVault Information Security Policy \u00a7 4.3,\u201d which is not in our file; Exhibit F Row #\u00a0s 5, "
  "8, 11, 14, 15, 18, 21, 24 and 26 record nine single-file FILE_DOWNLOAD events to "
  "\u201cLocal Disk (C:\\Users\\mholt\\Downloads)\u201d between 01/10/2018 and 02/01/2018, each with Event "
  "Status \u201cSuccess\u201d and Flag \u201cNone.\u201d",
  "Distinguishes the contractual rule from the actual operating practice. If routine downloads to local "
  "disk were unremarked and unflagged, that context matters to how the later events are read; it also "
  "identifies the policy document we must obtain from SkyVault."),

q("H-4", "Tell us about the series of Confluence exports in the first week of February 2018 \u2014 what you "
         "were doing, at whose request, and what you did with the exported material.",
  "Exhibit F, Forensic Log, Row #\u00a0s 27\u201332 record six BULK_EXPORT events to local disk between "
  "02/02/2018 and 02/08/2018: /SensorFusion/Archives/ (347 files, 1,842.6 MB), /FlightPath/ (218 files, "
  "1,105.3 MB), /SwarmProtocol/ (189 files, 924.7 MB), /HardwareIntegration/ (276 files, 2,214.8 MB), "
  "/SensorFusion/ (412 files, 3,127.4 MB) and /Business/CustomerData/ (84 files, 467.2 MB) \u2014 1,526 files "
  "in total. The Complaint pleads only the single 4,700-file transfer (\u00b6\u00b6 48\u201350) and does not "
  "mention these six events.",
  "These exports are in SkyVault's own exhibit but outside its pleaded theory. Whether they were ordinary "
  "work product, a project handover, or something else is a fact only the witness can supply, and it also "
  "bears on whether the later 4,700 figure double-counts material already exported."),

q("H-5", "Tell us everything you remember about the evening of February 8, 2018 at workstation "
         "SV-ENG-WS-014 \u2014 what you were doing, why, how long it took, who else knew, and whether anyone "
         "authorized it.",
  "Exhibit F, Forensic Log, Row #\u00a033 (USB_DEVICE_CONNECTED, timestamp 2018-02-09T02:17:44Z, Event Time "
  "(CT) field reading \u201c08:17:44 PM (02/08 CT)\u201d), Row #\u00a034 (BULK_COPY_TO_REMOVABLE, "
  "2018-02-09T02:18:12Z, 4,700 files, 18,473.2 MB, destination \u201cRemovable Disk "
  "(F:\\SkyVault_Export\\)\u201d, Flag \u201cALERT \u2014 Bulk transfer to removable media exceeds threshold "
  "(>500 files)\u201d) and Row #\u00a035 (USB_DEVICE_DISCONNECTED, 2018-02-09T03:42:58Z). Complaint \u00b6\u00b6 48 "
  "and 50 characterize the same event as occurring \u201con or about February 9, 2018.\u201d",
  "This is the single most important open-ended question in the investigation and must be asked before any "
  "record is shown. It also surfaces the date discrepancy: the exhibit's own Central Time field places the "
  "connection and copy on the evening of February 8, not February 9, which matters for corroboration "

q("H-6", "Whose storage device was it, how did you come by it, and where is it now?",
  "Exhibit F, Forensic Log, Row #\u00a0s 33\u201335, Device ID field: "
  "\u201cUSB\\VID_0781&PID_5581\\4C530001221029118035 (SanDisk Ultra 128GB)\u201d \u2014 which records a hardware "
  "identifier but says nothing about ownership; Complaint \u00b6 48 supplies the characterization \u201cpersonal "
  "USB storage device\u201d; ECIAA \u00a7 4.2 makes ownership legally relevant because the prior-written-approval "
  "requirement is directed at personal devices.",
  "Ownership is pleaded, not proven. The answer also drives an immediate preservation instruction: if the "
  "device or any image of it exists, it must be sequestered now."),

q("H-7", "Did you ask for, or receive, written approval to connect that device or to transfer that "

  "ECIAA \u00a7 4.2 (prior written approval of the supervisor or the IT department required); Exhibit F "
  "Row #\u00a034, where Event Status is \u201cSuccess\u201d and the transfer was permitted to complete despite the "

  "Authorization is an element-level fact for the \u201cimproper means\u201d and breach theories. A contemporaneous "

q("H-8", "Describe your exit interview and the separation process \u2014 who attended, what was asked of you, "

  "Exhibit F Row #\u00a040 (02/12/2018 ADMIN_NOTE: exit interview confirmed with HR Director K. Patel and "

  "Row #\u00a046 is a hearsay note written by SkyVault's own IT administrator summarizing an interview he did "

q("H-9", "What did you actually return, delete or certify at separation, and what, if anything, did you "

  "ECIAA \u00a7 3.5(a)\u2013(c) and the concluding sentence of \u00a7 3.5 (no retention of copies, summaries, "

  "Establishes the contractual-performance facts directly rather than through SkyVault's characterization, "

  "immediately."),

q("H-10", "Between February 13 and February 16, 2018, did you try to access SkyVault systems, and if so, "
          "what were you trying to do?",
  "Exhibit F Row #\u00a0s 42 and 43 (02/13/2018 ACCESS_REVOKED across all Confluence spaces and "

  "Status \u201cFailed \u2014 Access Revoked\u201d).",
  "A failed login after revocation is the kind of event that reads badly if left unexplained and is often "
  "entirely mundane. Resolving it now prevents it from being first explained under oath."),

q("H-11", "Since February 2018, what has become of any material that originated at SkyVault \u2014 on any "
          "device, personal cloud account, personal email account, or backup you control?",
  "ECIAA \u00a7 3.5 (return and deletion obligations) and \u00a7 3.2(a) (perpetual trade-secret obligation) frame "
  "the continuing duty; Exhibit F Report Metadata, B7, limits the log's scope to January 1 through "
  "February 28, 2018, so the exhibit is silent on everything after that date.",
  "Present possession, custody or control is both a live contractual question and the trigger for a "
  "targeted forensic collection of the witness's personal devices. Nothing in our file speaks to it."),

q("H-12", "Were you named as an inventor on any SkyVault patent application, were you ever asked to review "
          "or sign one, and what did you know at the time about SkyVault's patent filings?",
  "Complaint \u00b6\u00b6 28\u201330 identify the named inventors of the three patents-in-suit as Dr. Mehta "
  "('561), Dr. Mehta and Dr. Venkatesh ('227), and Dr. Mehta, Dr. Venkatesh and Kevin Larsson ('889) \u2014 "
  "Holt is named on none of them; \u00b6\u00b6 69, 78 and 86 allege on information and belief that he was "
  "nonetheless aware of the applications, including the '561 application filed March 14, 2017 during his "
  "employment; ECIAA \u00a7\u00a7 5.1 and 5.5 impose disclosure and prosecution-cooperation duties that would "
  "normally generate records if he had contributed inventively.",
  "Goes to the willfulness allegations, which rest on pre-suit knowledge, and simultaneously to \u00b6 128(b)'s "
  "failure-to-assign theory. Note the timing asymmetry to be explored: the '227 was filed November 9, 2018 "
  "and the '889 on June 22, 2020, both after the witness's February 16, 2018 departure."),

h(2, "B.  Lead Family 2 \u2014 Holt's Disclosed Prior Work and Pre-Existing Inventions")

q("H-13", "Take us through Exhibit A to your ECIAA \u2014 how you prepared it, what you understood it to "
          "cover, and whether the list is complete as of June 2016.",
  "ECIAA Exhibit A, initialed \u201cM.H.\u201d and dated June 13, 2016, listing two prior inventions: "
  "\u201cAutonomous Ground Vehicle Path Planning Algorithm\u201d (2014\u20132015, developed as part of PhD "
  "dissertation research at Georgia Institute of Technology, no patent filed) and \u201cRoboNav Sensor "
  "Calibration Toolkit (open-source)\u201d (2015, published on GitHub under MIT License at "
  "github.com/mholt-robotics/robonav-cal); ECIAA \u00a7 5.3 governs the effect of the listing.",
  "The Complaint never mentions this disclosure. It is contemporaneous, signed, and dated at the start of "
  "employment, and it is the most concrete documentary anchor available for a pre-existing-work narrative. "
  "Its completeness must be tested now, because an omission would be more damaging than the disclosure is "
  "helpful."),

q("H-14", "Describe the technical content of the dissertation path-planning work \u2014 what problem it "
          "solved, what the algorithm did, what was published, and whether any of it reappears in PathForge.",
  "ECIAA Exhibit A, item 1 (ground-vehicle path planning, 2014\u20132015, dissertation research, no patent "
  "filed); ECIAA \u00a7 5.3 (exclusion does not apply where the invention relates to the Company's business or "
  "results from work performed for the Company); white paper \u00a7 4.3 describes PathForge's \u201cadaptive "
  "flight path optimization algorithm\u201d, which is the module SkyVault maps to the '227 Patent at "
  "Complaint \u00b6 77.",
  "Tests the reach and the limits of the prior-invention carve-out: the disclosure is for ground vehicles, "
  "the accused module is aerial, and the \u00a7 5.3 carve-back language must be confronted rather than "
  "assumed away. Also identifies publicly available dissertation and publication records that can be "
  "obtained without discovery."),

q("H-15", "Tell us about the RoboNav toolkit \u2014 who wrote it, what license it carries, whether it or any "
          "derivative of it is in PathForge today, and how attribution was handled if so.",
  "ECIAA Exhibit A, item 2 (RoboNav Sensor Calibration Toolkit, 2015, GitHub, MIT License, "
  "github.com/mholt-robotics/robonav-cal); white paper \u00a7 3.1 and \u00a7 7.2 describe a \u201csensor "
  "calibration pipeline\u201d refined during the Q3 2018\u2013Q4 2019 fusion-module work, which is the nearest "
  "functional counterpart in the accused platform.",
  "If the witness's own MIT-licensed code is in PathForge, that is affirmative independent-provenance "
  "evidence \u2014 but only if the attribution and notice requirements of the MIT license were met. The "
  "question must be asked in a way that permits an unfavorable answer."),

q("H-16", "What other work did you do before June 2016 that is not on Exhibit A \u2014 publications, "
          "conference papers, code, teaching materials, consulting, or open-source contributions?",
  "ECIAA \u00a7 5.3 (final sentence: if no prior inventions are listed, the employee represents there are "
  "none) and Exhibit A as executed; ECIAA \u00a7 2.1(ii) (the prior-knowledge carve-out from Confidential "
  "Information requires documentation \u201cby written records\u201d).",
  "The \u00a7 2.1(ii) and \u00a7 2.1(iii) carve-outs are only usable if contemporaneous written records exist. "
  "This question is the fastest route to identifying them and to learning whether Exhibit A understates "
  "the witness's pre-employment portfolio."),

q("H-17", "During your SkyVault employment, did you develop anything on your own time, on your own "
          "equipment, related to autonomous navigation \u2014 and did you disclose it to SkyVault?",
  "ECIAA \u00a7 5.1 (prompt written disclosure of all inventions conceived during employment, on or off "
  "premises and inside or outside business hours) and \u00a7 5.3 (own-time exclusion and its carve-back); "
  "Complaint \u00b6 128(b) alleges breach of \u00a7 5 for failure to assign.",
  "Directly addresses the pleaded failure-to-assign theory, and identifies any conception that occurred "
  "before February 16, 2018 \u2014 the single most legally consequential category of fact for both the "
  "assignment claim and the PathForge conception timeline."),

q("H-18", "Between February 16 and April 11, 2018, what technical work did you do, on what equipment, with "
          "whom, and what records of it exist?",
  "Complaint \u00b6 53 (Meridian co-founded on or about April 11, 2018) and \u00b6 9 (Delaware formation April 11, "
  "2018) fix the corporate start date; white paper \u00a7 1 states PathForge was \u201cdeveloped from the ground "
  "up beginning in 2018\u201d and \u00a7 7.2 dates the start of development to April 2018 at incorporation.",
  "There is an unaccounted eight-week window between departure and incorporation. SkyVault's \u00b6 54 theory "
  "depends on characterizing the post-departure period as continuous misuse; whatever actually happened in "
  "that window \u2014 including nothing \u2014 needs to be established from the witness and from records "
  "(personal devices, notebooks, incorporation files, investor materials) before anyone else defines it."),

q("H-19", "Where did you personally draw the line between the general skills and knowledge you took with "
          "you and SkyVault's confidential information, and how did you apply that line at Meridian?",
  "ECIAA \u00a7 3.4 (express preservation of the right to use general skills, knowledge, experience and "
  "expertise, and publicly available information, provided no Confidential Information or Trade Secrets "
  "are used); \u00a7 3.2(b) (non-trade-secret confidentiality obligations ran three years from termination, "
  "i.e., to February 16, 2021); Complaint \u00b6 129 lists the categories SkyVault says were used.",
  "\u00a7 3.4 is the contractual hinge of any independent-development position. The witness's contemporaneous "
  "understanding \u2014 and any instruction he gave his team \u2014 is a fact, and the answer will show whether "
  "the line was drawn deliberately or never considered."),

h(2, "C.  Lead Family 3 \u2014 The Origin of PathForge Development")

para("The questions in this family must be asked module by module, and within each module must separate "
     "conception from architecture, architecture from implementation, implementation from third-party "
     "dependencies, and all of those from testing and release. A single global question about \u201chow "
     "PathForge was built\u201d will produce an answer that cannot be tested against any record.", after=8)

q("H-20", "For the multi-sensor fusion module: who conceived the architecture, when, what were the first "
          "written artifacts, and who wrote the initial implementation?",
  "White paper \u00a7 3.1 (sensor suite, EKF state vector, noise covariance weighting), \u00a7 3.2 (the "
  "seven-stage pipeline) and \u00a7 7.2 (\u201cQ3 2018 \u2013 Q4 2019: Multi-sensor fusion module designed and "
  "prototyped\u201d); Complaint \u00b6\u00b6 66\u201368 and the claim chart following \u00b6 67 accuse this module under "
  "the '561 Patent.",
  "This is the module tied to the only patent-in-suit with a priority date (March 14, 2017) inside the "
  "witness's SkyVault tenure. Conception date, first artifact and first author are the three facts that "
  "make an independent-development account provable or not."),

q("H-21", "For the GPS-denied navigation module, including the adaptive path optimization in \u00a7 4.3: same "
          "questions \u2014 conception, first artifacts, implementers, and the sequence in which the "
          "sub-components were built.",
  "White paper \u00a7 4.2 (VIO pipeline: feature extraction and tracking, sliding-window optimization, "
  "keyframe-based map management, IMU pre-integration, plus the three claimed engineering additions), "
  "\u00a7 4.3 (uncertainty-aware replanning) and \u00a7 7.2 (\u201cQ1 2019 \u2013 Q3 2020\u201d); Complaint \u00b6 77 "
  "accuses this module under the '227 Patent, which was filed November 9, 2018.",
  "The white paper's own timeline places the start of this module's development within roughly one quarter "
  "of the '227 filing date and long after the witness's departure. Establishing the actual internal "
  "chronology is necessary both to the independent-development account and to any later assessment of what "
  "was publicly known when."),

q("H-22", "For the swarm coordination module: same questions, and please reconcile the two dates the white "
          "paper gives for when that work began.",
  "White paper \u00a7 5.1 states the swarm module \u201cwas developed beginning in 2019, with first production "
  "deployment in early 2021\u201d; \u00a7 7.2 gives \u201cQ2 2019 \u2013 Q1 2021\u201d for the same work; \u00a7\u00a7 5.2 "
  "and 5.3 describe the mesh protocol, the 10 Hz heartbeat, the three-round consensus and the "
  "priority-based deconfliction; Complaint \u00b6 85 accuses this module under the '889 Patent, filed "
  "June 22, 2020.",
  "If Meridian's swarm work began in 2019 and the '889 was not filed until June 2020, the chronology is "
  "material to both the misappropriation theory and to questions of what was independently developed and "
  "when. The witness should reconcile his own published dates before anyone else does."),

q("H-23", "For the Analytics Dashboard and the Hardware Integration Layer: who built them, when, and were "
          "they ever technically coupled to the navigation or swarm code?",
  "White paper \u00a7 7.1 items 3 and 4 (the two optional add-on modules) and \u00a7 7.2 (the September 2020 v1.0 "
  "launch \u201cinitially comprising the Navigation Module and Hardware Integration Layer\u201d; Analytics "
  "Dashboard released Q3 2021); Complaint \u00b6\u00b6 56 and 59 treat \u201cPathForge\u201d as a single accused "
  "platform generating in excess of $50 million in cumulative revenue.",
  "SkyVault accuses the platform as a whole and attributes all PathForge revenue to the alleged "
  "misappropriation (\u00b6 146). Module separability is therefore a fact question with direct consequences, "
  "and two of the four modules are not touched by any accusation in the Complaint."),

q("H-24", "For each module, who else contributed \u2014 employees, contractors, interns, acquired teams \u2014 "
          "and did any of them previously work at SkyVault?",
  "White paper \u00a7 1 (a dedicated engineering team of approximately 45 working full-time on PathForge) and "
  "\u00a7 7.2 (\u201cAll PathForge technology was developed independently by the Meridian engineering team\u201d); "
  "ECIAA \u00a7 7.1 prohibited soliciting or hiring SkyVault employees for twelve months after termination, "
  "i.e., through February 16, 2019, and extends to anyone who was a SkyVault employee within the preceding "
  "six months; Complaint \u00b6 55 alleges on information and belief that Holt disclosed SkyVault material to "
  "Meridian engineers.",
  "Identifies the additional interview population and tests a contractual exposure the Complaint does not "
  "currently plead. A SkyVault-to-Meridian personnel path, if one exists, must be found by us first."),

q("H-25", "Where does PathForge source code live, what version-control system has it used since 2018, and "
          "is the commit history complete and unaltered?",
  "White paper \u00a7 7.2 (development beginning April 2018) supplies the period that must be covered; "
  "Complaint \u00b6\u00b6 118\u2013120 allege that PathForge firmware contains direct copies, modified versions or "
  "derivative works of AeroCore code; the April 5, 2024 letter, item 3, declined a pre-litigation source "
  "code audit as premature and overbroad outside formal litigation with protective measures.",
  "Repository integrity determines whether independent development is provable at all. A complete "
  "incremental history from 2018 is the strongest available answer to \u00b6 119's \u201ccannot be explained by "
  "independent creation\u201d allegation; any gap, import or rewrite must be known to us now rather than "
  "discovered in production."),

q("H-26", "What third-party and open-source components does PathForge incorporate, how are they declared, "
          "and who approves a new dependency?",
  "White paper \u00a7 2 and \u00a7 7.2 describe reliance on published literature and \u201cpublicly available "
  "implementations\u201d; the April 5, 2024 letter asserts that Meridian \u201cmaintains robust internal "
  "compliance processes designed to safeguard against the unauthorized use of third-party intellectual "
  "property.\u201d",
  "Substantiates or undercuts a representation already made in writing to opposing counsel. Dependency "
  "manifests are also the quickest objective test of whether any externally sourced code entered the "
  "platform and when."),

q("H-27", "What testing and benchmark records support the performance figures published in the white paper?",
  "White paper \u00a7 3.3 and Table 0 (99.7% detection rate, <0.2% false positives, 38 ms latency, 8 cm RMS "
  "structured / 14 cm RMS unstructured), \u00a7 4.4 and Table 1 (<0.5% drift, 45-minute maximum GPS-denied "
  "flight, 97.3% mission completion, tested in a 10,000 sq. ft. warehouse, a 1.2 km utility tunnel and a "
  "simulated urban canyon) and \u00a7 5.4 and Table 2 (24-drone maximum tested swarm, 14 ms inter-drone "
  "latency, zero collisions across 1,200+ hours).",
  "Contemporaneous test data is independent-development evidence of a kind that is difficult to "
  "reconstruct after the fact: it shows iterative engineering with failures and revisions. It is also the "
  "only way to determine whether the published figures were measured or aspirational."),

q("H-28", "Did any file, document, excerpt, or fragment originating at SkyVault ever reach a Meridian "
          "system, device, repository, or person \u2014 directly or indirectly, then or since?",
  "Exhibit F, Report Metadata, B7, limits the log to SkyVault systems and to the period January 1 through "
  "February 28, 2018, and the Forensic Log contains no event connecting the SanDisk device (Row #\u00a0s "
  "33\u201335) to anything outside SkyVault; Complaint \u00b6\u00b6 54\u201355 and 95 allege the connection on "
  "information and belief.",
  "This is the factual bridge SkyVault's entire case requires and that its own exhibit does not span. The "
  "question must be asked squarely, in open form, and the answer documented precisely \u2014 including any "
  "qualification \u2014 because it is the answer we will be held to."),

q("H-29", "Do the file names navfusion.c, pathoptengine.h or swarm_proto.cpp mean anything to you, and do "
          "files by those or similar names exist anywhere at Meridian?",
  "Complaint \u00b6\u00b6 33, 116 and 118 identify those three files as the AeroCore source files alleged to be "
  "substantially similar to PathForge firmware; Exhibit F records no .c, .h or .cpp artifact at all \u2014 "
  "the only code-like objects in the log are Row #\u00a08 (sf_point_cloud_processor_v1.4.py) and Row #\u00a015 "
  "(swarm_failover_logic_v1.2.py), both single-file downloads to local disk, and every bulk event lists "
  "Confluence wiki spaces rather than a source-code repository.",
  "Isolates the copyright theory from the trade-secret theory. The Complaint's copying allegation rests on "
  "three named source files, while its only forensic exhibit documents wiki-space exports \u2014 a gap that "
  "should be tested with the witness before it is tested in discovery."),

h(2, "D.  Lead Family 4 \u2014 The White Paper: Title, Authorship and Provenance")

  "\u201cPublic Release / Marketing Technical Paper\u201d) and the closing legend \u201cPathForge White Paper "
  "v1.0 \u2014 July 2022\u201d; Complaint \u00b6 57 attributes the document to \u201cDr. Marcus Holt and the "
  "Meridian engineering team\u201d and \u00b6\u00b6 97 and 109 make the same document SkyVault's claimed date of "
  "discovery.",
  "SkyVault relies on the white paper both as its infringement evidence and as its limitations trigger. "
  "Personal authorship of specific sections determines which statements are attributable to this witness "
  "and which are collective or marketing-authored."),

q("H-31", "Is the July 2022 v1.0 the only version of this paper, and where and to whom was it published or "
          "distributed?",
  "White paper closing legend (\u201cv1.0 \u2014 July 2022\u201d) and the copyright notice stating that the "
  "technical descriptions \u201crepresent PathForge capabilities as of the date of publication \u2026 and are "
  "subject to change\u201d; Complaint \u00b6 57 pleads publication \u201cin or about July 2022.\u201d",
  "Version control over the document matters because SkyVault's discovery allegation is keyed to "
  "publication and because its claim chart quotes language we cannot locate in the version we hold "
  "(see H-33). Distribution scope also bears on public availability."),

q("H-32", "Who prepared the excerpt in circulation, when, and for what purpose \u2014 and what exactly is "
          "missing from it?",
  "The excerpt's own front-matter states that it is \u201can excerpt of the full PathForge Technical White "
  "Paper (42 pages)\u201d and \u201ccontains Sections 1\u20135 and Section 7, omitting detailed hardware "
  "specifications (Section 6) and appendices\u201d \u2014 yet the excerpt as received also contains a Section 8 "

  "Authentication and completeness. The excerpt's self-description does not match its contents, so the "
  "provenance of the excerpt itself must be established before any comparison drawn from it \u2014 by either "
  "side \u2014 is relied upon. The complete 42-page v1.0 must be located and preserved."),

q("H-33", "Have the terms \u201cSensor Integration Layer,\u201d \u201cThreat Assessment Module,\u201d "
          "\u201cDynamic Path Replanner\u201d or \u201cFlight Controller API\u201d ever been used at Meridian \u2014 "
          "in a document, a code identifier, an API name, a specification, or marketing material?",
  "The Complaint's '561 claim chart following \u00b6 67 attributes each of those component names to the white "
  "paper and quotes specific language from \u201cSection 2.1,\u201d \u201cSection 3.1,\u201d \u201cSection 3.2\u201d "
  "(a \u201cunified three-dimensional environmental model refreshed at 30 Hz\u201d), \u201cSection 4.1,\u201d "
  "\u201cSection 4.3\u201d (alternative trajectories \u201cin under 50 milliseconds\u201d) and \u201cSection "
  "5.1\u201d; none of those four component names, and none of the quoted phrases, appears anywhere in the "
  "white-paper excerpt we hold, whose \u00a7 3.1 is \u201cArchitecture Overview,\u201d \u00a7 3.2 is \u201cObstacle "
  "Detection and Avoidance Pipeline,\u201d \u00a7 4.1 is \u201cProblem Statement,\u201d \u00a7 4.3 is \u201cAdaptive "
  "Flight Path Optimization\u201d and \u00a7 5.1 is the swarm \u201cOverview,\u201d and which reports a 38 ms "
  "measured latency rather than a 30 Hz refresh or a 50 ms replanning figure.",
  "Determines whether SkyVault is quoting a different Meridian document, a different version of this one, "
  "the unidentified \u201cmarketing materials\u201d its chart also invokes at limitation 1[a], or is "
  "mischaracterizing the paper. The answer is needed before the partner assesses the claim chart, and it "
  "identifies documents we must collect either way."),

q("H-34", "What marketing materials describing the PathForge sensor hardware configuration existed as of "
          "2024, and who produced them?",
  "The Complaint's claim chart at limitation 1[a] states that \u201cMeridian's marketing materials similarly "
  "describe the PathForge sensor hardware configuration,\u201d without identifying them; white paper \u00a7 3.1 "
  "describes the sensor suite (360-degree LiDAR at 20 Hz to 120 m, stereo cameras at 30 fps from 0.5 to "
  "30 m, a 6-axis IMU at 200 Hz, and ultrasonic sensors to 5 m).",
  "Identifies an unnamed category of accused evidence. Marketing descriptions are drafted to persuade and "
  "may diverge from the as-built system; we need the full set before any technical comparison is attempted."),

q("H-35", "Were the published performance figures measured, targeted, or aspirational \u2014 and who verified "
          "them before publication?",
  "White paper \u00a7 1 (\u201csub-40-millisecond latency\u201d, accuracy \u201cwithin 10 centimeters\u201d), "
  "\u00a7 3.1 (\u201ca target obstacle detection latency of under 40 milliseconds\u201d), \u00a7 3.3 and Table 0 "
  "(38 ms and 8 cm as recorded results, and the claimed 19% and 47% improvements over Vasquez (2016)); the "
  "cover classification \u201cPublic Release / Marketing Technical Paper.\u201d",
  "The document mixes design targets with measured results in adjacent sentences. Because SkyVault's "
  "infringement chart reads the paper as an engineering specification, the distinction between target and "
  "measurement must be established from the author and from the underlying test data."),

h(2, "E.  Lead Family 5 \u2014 DroneNav and Other Public Sources")

para("For every public source, the questions must separate eight distinct states, because they carry "
     "different legal consequences: awareness of the source; citation of it; evaluation or benchmarking of "
     "it; cloning or downloading the code; introducing it as a build dependency; modifying or adapting it; "
     "using it in the shipped product; and considering but not using it. A witness who answers \u201cwe used "
     "DroneNav\u201d has told us almost nothing.", after=8)

q("H-36", "When and how did you first become aware of the DroneNav project?",
  "White paper \u00a7 2 and \u00a7 4.2 describe DroneNav as an open-source visual-inertial odometry project, "
  "Reference 2 gives \u201cDroneNav Project, GitHub Repository, first committed August 15, 2017, "
  "https://github.com/dronenav/dronenav\u201d, and \u00a7 7.2 states that the GPS-denied module's design was "
  "\u201cinformed by \u2026 publicly available implementations including the DroneNav open-source project "
  "(2017)\u201d; Complaint \u00b6 43 places the witness at SkyVault until February 16, 2018, so the first-commit "
  "date falls inside his SkyVault tenure.",
  "Fixes the date of awareness relative to employment. Public availability as of August 2017 is also "
  "potentially relevant to what was and was not secret, but only if the timing and the content of the "
  "public disclosure are established precisely."),

q("H-37", "Distinguish for us what was actually done with the DroneNav codebase: was it read in a browser, "
          "cloned or downloaded, built and run, benchmarked against PathForge, adapted, or linked in as a "
          "dependency \u2014 and by whom and when in each case?",
  "White paper \u00a7 4.2 states that DroneNav's \u201cpublicly available codebase implemented the core pipeline "
  "of feature tracking, sliding-window optimization, keyframe management, and IMU pre-integration for "
  "monocular camera configurations\u201d and that PathForge's VIO pipeline \u201cwas developed independently, "
  "drawing on the same well-known algorithmic foundations\u201d; \u00a7 4.3 says PathForge \u201cextends the "
  "foundational VIO-based navigation demonstrated in projects like DroneNav.\u201d",
  "The white paper asserts conceptual influence and independent implementation in the same breath. Which "
  "of the eight states above actually occurred is a factual question with sharply different consequences "
  "for copyright, licensing and independent development, and it can be corroborated against clone logs, "
  "build manifests and machine artifacts."),

q("H-38", "What license does DroneNav carry, and what license-compliance steps were taken by anyone at "
          "Meridian in relation to it?",
  "White paper Reference 2 and \u00a7 4.2 identify the repository but state no license; the April 5, 2024 "
  "letter asserts \u201crobust internal compliance processes designed to safeguard against the unauthorized "
  "use of third-party intellectual property.\u201d",
  "An open-source obligation is a live risk independent of SkyVault's claims, and an unmet one would "
  "directly contradict a representation already made to opposing counsel. We need to know before SkyVault "
  "does."),

q("H-39", "Did you ever contribute to DroneNav, correspond with its maintainers, or discuss it with anyone "
          "while you were at SkyVault?",
  "White paper Reference 2 (first commit August 15, 2017); Complaint \u00b6\u00b6 43\u201344 (employment through "
  "February 16, 2018, with access to SkyVault's swarm and sensor-fusion material); ECIAA \u00a7 3.1(b)\u2013(c) "
  "(no disclosure or outside use of Confidential Information) and \u00a7 5.1 (disclosure of inventions "
  "conceived during employment, on or off premises).",
  "A contribution made during employment would implicate both the confidentiality and the "
  "invention-disclosure provisions. This is an unpleasant question that must be asked now rather than at a "
  "deposition."),

q("H-40", "Take the three cited academic works in turn \u2014 Vasquez (2016), Nakamura and Okonkwo (2015), "
          "and Ferreira (2016): when did you read each, what did you take from it, and did implementation "
          "proceed from the paper itself or from someone's code?",
  "White paper \u00a7 2 and \u00a7 3.1 describe Vasquez as establishing the LiDAR/stereo/IMU extended-Kalman-"
  "filter framework and \u00a7 3.2 states that PathForge's fusion methodology \u201cdirectly implements the "
  "framework described by Vasquez (2016)\u201d; \u00a7 3.3 compares PathForge's results against Vasquez's "
  "reported 47 ms and 15 cm; \u00a7 5.2 attributes the swarm design to distributed-systems and MANET "
  "literature citing Ferreira et al. (2016); References 1, 3 and 4 give full citations "
  "(IEEE Transactions on Robotics, Vol. 32, No. 5, pp. 1142\u20131158, October 2016; Journal of Autonomous "
  "Robotics, Vol. 14, No. 3, pp. 287\u2013305, 2015; and ICRA 2016, pp. 4421\u20134428).",
  "Published prior art is obtainable without discovery and supports both a public-availability position "
  "and a technical account of where the architecture came from. The phrase \u201cdirectly implements,\u201d "
  "which the author chose, needs to be explained by him in operational terms."),

q("H-41", "What other public sources \u2014 repositories, datasets, standards, reference designs, commercial "
          "SDKs \u2014 were consulted, and which were considered and deliberately not used?",
  "White paper \u00a7 2 (\u201ca rich body of academic research and early open-source implementations\u201d and "
  "\u201ca thorough review of the published literature\u201d), \u00a7 7.2 (\u201cbuilds upon publicly available "
  "academic research and open-source implementations that are widely known in the autonomous systems "
  "community\u201d) and \u00a7 5.2 (MANET literature generally).",
  "The rejected-alternatives trail is undervalued and highly probative: a documented decision not to use a "
  "source demonstrates that sources were being evaluated deliberately, which is the practical signature of "
  "independent development."),

h(2, "F.  Lead Family 6 \u2014 The Pre-Suit Correspondence Chain")

q("H-42", "When did you first learn of SkyVault's March 12, 2024 letter, from whom, and what did you do "
          "next?",
  "Complaint \u00b6 61 records the letter's date, that it was sent by Callister, Voss & Greenbaum LLP and "
  "addressed to CEO Priya Chandrasekaran at Meridian's Austin headquarters, that it identified the three "
  "patents-in-suit and described the trade-secret and copyright claims, and that it made three demands "
  "(cessation; $15 million in licensing fees; a full forensic audit of source code repositories); the "
  "April 5, 2024 Brackwell & Haines letter acknowledges receipt of that correspondence. The letter itself "
  "is not in our file and nothing beyond these two records may be attributed to it.",
  "Fixes the notice date on which the willfulness allegations of \u00b6\u00b6 63, 70, 78 and 86 depend. The date "
  "of receipt and the internal routing are ordinary facts, not privileged communications."),

q("H-43", "Before March 2024, had you or anyone at Meridian heard from SkyVault, Dr. Mehta, or their "
          "counsel about PathForge \u2014 in any form, including informally at conferences or through "
          "customers or investors?",
  "Exhibit F Row #\u00a045 records that Hargrove Forensics Group was engaged on 02/14/2018 \u201cper counsel "
  "authorization\u201d and Row #\u00a050 records on 02/16/2018 that the matter was \u201creferred to legal counsel "
  "at Callister, Voss & Greenbaum LLP\u201d; the Report Metadata, B5\u2013B6, show the forensic report was "
  "prepared for that firm and dated March 5, 2018; Complaint \u00b6\u00b6 97 and 109 nonetheless allege that "
  "SkyVault first discovered the misappropriation on reviewing the July 2022 white paper.",
  "Exhibit F establishes that SkyVault knew of the transfer, engaged a forensic examiner and referred the "
  "matter to litigation counsel in February and March 2018 \u2014 more than six years before suit and more "
  "than four before the publication date SkyVault pleads as its discovery. Any contact during that period "
  "is a fact of first-order importance, and its complete absence is equally worth establishing."),

q("H-44", "What factual information did you personally supply in connection with Meridian's April 2024 "
          "response \u2014 identifying the facts and the documents, not any advice you received or any "
          "request counsel made of you?",
  "The April 5, 2024 letter states that \u201cMeridian independently developed its PathForge platform through "
  "the efforts of its engineering teams,\u201d that it \u201cmaintains robust internal compliance processes,\u201d "
  "and that it is \u201caware of none\u201d in the way of substantive support for the infringement assertions; "
  "the letter is cc'd to Jordan Kessler, VP of Legal.",
  "The underlying facts and documents a witness supplied are discoverable; the communications with counsel "
  "generally are not. The question is phrased to draw that line in the room. Interrupt and log if the "
  "witness begins describing counsel's advice or questions."),

q("H-45", "Since March 2024, have you had any contact with SkyVault personnel, or received any direct "
          "approach from SkyVault or its counsel?",
  "The April 5, 2024 letter requests that \u201cSkyVault and its counsel \u2026 refrain from contacting "
  "Meridian's officers and employees directly regarding these allegations\u201d and directs all future "
  "communications to Brackwell & Haines LLP.",
  "Tests compliance with the channel Meridian established, and surfaces any communication that would need "
  "to be preserved, disclosed, or raised with opposing counsel."),

h(1, "V.  Witness Category 2 \u2014 The Meridian Technical Team")

para("The technical team is the records-bearing witness group in this matter: unlike Dr. Holt, whose value "
     "is narrative, these witnesses can tell us what systems exist, what those systems retain, and what "
     "the surviving artifacts actually show about how each PathForge module was built. Their interviews "
     "should be conducted in small, subject-matter-specific sessions rather than as a single group meeting, "
     "and should be paired with live access to repositories, ticketing systems and test archives wherever "
     "possible. This group also supplies the internal counterpart to Exhibit F \u2014 the engineers and IT "
     "personnel who can say what a log record of that kind does and does not establish.")

h(2, "A.  Module Architecture, Contributors and Development Record")

q("T-1", "For each of the four modules identified in the white paper's modularity section, identify the "
         "technical owner over time and the engineers who wrote the principal components in each period.",
  "White paper \u00a7 7.1 (Navigation Module, Swarm Coordination Module, Analytics Dashboard, Hardware "
  "Integration Layer, described as \u201cindependently developed, independently deployable, and "
  "independently priced\u201d) and \u00a7 7.2 (the phased timeline); Complaint \u00b6\u00b6 66, 76 and 84 accuse "
  "different modules under different patents.",
  "Builds the authorship map that every provenance question depends on, and identifies the additional "
  "custodians whose files must be preserved and collected."),

q("T-2", "For each module, what design record survives \u2014 design documents, architecture decision "
         "records, review notes, tickets, sprint artifacts \u2014 and what is the earliest surviving item?",
  "White paper \u00a7 7.2 (fusion designed and prototyped Q3 2018\u2013Q4 2019; GPS-denied developed Q1 "
  "2019\u2013Q3 2020; swarm designed and tested Q2 2019\u2013Q1 2021) states what was done but produces no "
  "underlying record; Complaint \u00b6 54 asserts that the development timeline was too rapid to be "
  "independent.",
  "A contemporaneous design record answering the rapidity allegation is more persuasive than any witness "
  "statement. The earliest surviving artifact per module also defines the outer limit of what we can prove."),

q("T-3", "Are the four modules genuinely separable in the build system \u2014 can each be built, licensed and "
         "shipped independently, and what in the repository and release tooling demonstrates that?",
  "White paper \u00a7 7.1 (modules \u201ccan be licensed and deployed independently or together\u201d; customers "
  "may license only what they need) and \u00a7 5.4 (the swarm module described as \u201cone of multiple distinct "
  "technology components\u201d each \u201cdeveloped as an independent engineering effort\u201d); Complaint \u00b6 146 "
  "asserts that the entirety of PathForge revenue is attributable to the alleged misappropriation.",
  "Module separability is the factual predicate for any apportionment position and for confining "
  "module-specific allegations to the modules actually accused. The claim in the white paper must be "
  "corroborated from the build system, not accepted from marketing copy."),

h(2, "B.  Repositories, Code Provenance and Dependencies")

q("T-4", "What version-control systems has PathForge used since 2018, when was each adopted, and has "
         "history ever been imported, rewritten, squashed or migrated?",
  "White paper \u00a7 7.2 (development beginning April 2018); Complaint \u00b6 119 alleges similarities in "
  "\u201cstructure, sequence, and organization\u201d that \u201ccannot be explained by independent creation\u201d; "
  "the April 5, 2024 letter, item 3, declined a pre-suit source-code audit outside formal litigation.",
  "Determines whether an incremental development history exists to rebut \u00b6 119. Any migration or history "
  "rewrite must be identified and explained by us proactively, because it will otherwise be characterized "
  "as spoliation."),

q("T-5", "What are the earliest surviving commits in each module \u2014 date, author, and size \u2014 and is "
         "there any large initial import of unattributed code?",
  "White paper \u00a7 7.2 places the start of PathForge development in April 2018 and states that \u201call "
  "PathForge technology was developed independently by the Meridian engineering team\u201d; Complaint "
  "\u00b6\u00b6 54 and 120 allege that the platform was built from misappropriated material.",
  "A large, unattributed initial import is the clearest technical signature of transferred code; an "
  "incremental early history is correspondingly strong evidence of independent development. Either way we "
  "must know before anyone else looks."),

q("T-6", "Do dependency manifests and software bills of materials exist for each release, and does DroneNav "
         "\u2014 or any fork or vendored copy of it \u2014 appear in any of them, currently or historically?",
  "White paper \u00a7 4.2 and \u00a7 7.2 (DroneNav described as an informing reference for the GPS-denied "
  "module) and Reference 2 (github.com/dronenav/dronenav, first committed August 15, 2017); the "
  "April 5, 2024 letter's compliance-process representation.",
  "Converts the white paper's narrative statement about DroneNav into a verifiable fact, and tests whether "
  "conceptual influence ever became a code dependency. Historical manifests matter as much as current ones."),

q("T-7", "Do files named navfusion.c, pathoptengine.h or swarm_proto.cpp, or any files bearing SkyVault or "
         "AeroCore identifiers, headers, comments or author strings, exist anywhere in the PathForge tree or "
         "its history?",
  "Complaint \u00b6\u00b6 33, 116 and 118 name those three AeroCore files; Exhibit F's Forensic Log contains no "
  ".c, .h or .cpp artifact, and its bulk events reference Confluence wiki spaces "
  "(/SkyVault/Engineering/SensorFusion/, /FlightPath/, /SwarmProtocol/, /HardwareIntegration/ and "
  "/Business/CustomerData/) rather than any source-code repository.",
  "A targeted, defensible internal search now \u2014 conducted under privilege and properly documented \u2014 "
  "is far preferable to a first search conducted under a production order."),

q("T-8", "What code-provenance, license-scanning or similarity tooling has Meridian run, at what gates, and "
         "are the historical reports retained?",
  "The April 5, 2024 letter asserts robust internal compliance processes safeguarding against unauthorized "
  "use of third-party intellectual property; white paper \u00a7 7.2 asserts independent development.",
  "Existing scan reports are contemporaneous business records rather than litigation work product, and "
  "they either substantiate the representation already made or reveal a gap that must be addressed now."),

h(2, "C.  Testing, Release and Documentation Records")

q("T-9", "What raw test data, flight logs and facility records support the three benchmark tables in the "
         "white paper, and where are they stored?",
  "White paper \u00a7 3.3 and Table 0, \u00a7 4.4 and Table 1 (including the 10,000 sq. ft. warehouse, 1.2 km "
  "utility tunnel and simulated urban canyon with 8\u201315 m building separations) and \u00a7 5.4 and Table 2 "
  "(24 drones, 14 ms, zero collisions across 1,200+ hours).",
  "Iterative test data spanning years is difficult to fabricate and directly answers the rapid-development "
  "inference in \u00b6 54. It also allows us to confirm whether published figures were measured."),

q("T-10", "What release artifacts exist for the September 2020 v1.0 launch, the Q1 2021 swarm production "
          "deployment and the Q3 2021 Analytics Dashboard release \u2014 and can a historical build be "
          "reconstructed today?",
  "White paper \u00a7 7.2 (the three release dates and the statement that v1.0 initially comprised the "
  "Navigation Module and Hardware Integration Layer) and \u00a7 1 (commercial launch September 2020, 60+ "
  "customers); Complaint \u00b6\u00b6 56 and 59 date the launch to September 2020 and allege in excess of $50 "
  "million in cumulative revenue since.",
  "Reproducible historical builds fix what the accused product actually was at each relevant date, rather "
  "than what a marketing document said it was."),

q("T-11", "Who assembled the technical content of white-paper Sections 3 through 5, who supplied the "
          "comparison figures attributed to Vasquez, and who created the circulating excerpt?",
  "White paper \u00a7 3.3 (comparing PathForge against Vasquez's reported 47 ms and 15 cm and claiming 19% "
  "and 47% improvements), the cover byline naming the \u201cPathForge Engineering Team,\u201d and the excerpt "
  "front-matter describing a 42-page original while the excerpt itself also contains Section 8 and the "
  "reference list; Complaint \u00b6 57 attributes the paper to Holt and \u201cthe Meridian engineering team.\u201d",
  "Establishes which statements are engineering statements and which are marketing statements, and fixes "
  "the provenance and completeness of the excerpt on which both sides are currently relying."),

q("T-12", "Have the component names quoted in SkyVault's claim chart ever been used in Meridian code, APIs, "
          "specifications or collateral?",
  "The Complaint's '561 claim chart following \u00b6 67 quotes a \u201cSensor Integration Layer,\u201d a "
  "\u201cThreat Assessment Module,\u201d a \u201cDynamic Path Replanner\u201d and a \u201cFlight Controller "
  "API,\u201d with a 30 Hz model refresh and a sub-50 ms replanning time, attributed to white-paper "
  "\u00a7\u00a7 2.1, 3.1, 3.2, 4.1, 4.3 and 5.1; none of those names or figures appears in the excerpt we hold, "
  "which instead reports a 38 ms measured detection-to-avoidance latency (Table 0).",
  "A code-and-document search for these four terms will show whether SkyVault quoted a different document, "
  "a different version, or inaccurately. This is a discrete, fast, high-value verification task."),

h(2, "D.  Internal Controls, Meridian-Side Records and Reading Exhibit F")

q("T-13", "What does Meridian require of new engineers concerning prior-employer materials, and are signed "
          "acknowledgments retained \u2014 including for the earliest hires in 2018?",
  "The April 5, 2024 letter's compliance-process representation; ECIAA \u00a7 7.1 (SkyVault non-solicitation "
  "running through February 16, 2019, extending to any person employed by SkyVault within the prior six "
  "months); Complaint \u00b6 55 (alleging disclosure to Meridian engineers).",
  "Onboarding records are the most direct evidence that the alleged inbound transfer did not occur, and "
  "they also identify any SkyVault-originating personnel path before SkyVault finds it."),

q("T-14", "What endpoint, removable-media and data-loss-prevention controls has Meridian had since 2018, "
          "and do the logs survive?",
  "Exhibit F Row #\u00a034 shows that SkyVault's Endpoint Security Agent (v4.1) generated an automated alert "
  "on a transfer exceeding a 500-file threshold but did not block it, illustrating the kind of record a "

q("T-15", "Has any device matching the identifier in Exhibit F ever been connected to a Meridian system, and "
          "does any directory or archive named \u201cSkyVault_Export\u201d exist anywhere in Meridian's "
          "environment?",
  "Exhibit F Row #\u00a0s 33\u201335, Device ID \u201cUSB\\VID_0781&PID_5581\\4C530001221029118035 (SanDisk "
  "Ultra 128GB)\u201d and destination path \u201cRemovable Disk (F:\\SkyVault_Export\\)\u201d.",
  "A specific, falsifiable search against the one identifier SkyVault's own exhibit supplies. A documented "

q("T-16", "Reading the bulk-transfer record as forensic practitioners: is the 4,700 figure deduplicated, "
          "does it overlap the earlier exports, is a single timestamp consistent with a transfer of that "
          "size, and what would the underlying systems natively record?",
  "Exhibit F Row #\u00a034 (4,700 files / 18,473.2 MB logged at a single timestamp, 2018-02-09T02:18:12Z, with "
  "Notes describing \u201capprox. 4,700 files (~18.1 GB)\u201d spanning five spaces) read against Row #\u00a0s "
  "27\u201332 (1,526 files already exported to local disk from those same five spaces between 02/02 and "

  "approximately 85-minute window); Report Metadata B8 lists the four underlying data sources (Confluence "
  "Server v6.12.2 audit logs, Endpoint Security Agent v4.1 event logs, Active Directory authentication "
  "logs, and the USB device connection registry).",
  "The 4,700 figure is repeated verbatim in \u00b6\u00b6 48, 49, 50, 94, 107 and 128(a) and is the quantitative "
  "spine of SkyVault's case. Whether it is a deduplicated count, a summary aggregate, or an overlap with "
  "earlier events is a technical question our own people can frame for a consulting expert now."),

q("T-17", "What would we need from SkyVault to identify the files actually transferred, and what fields "
          "would let us test the count and the content?",
  "Exhibit F's File/Object Name column reads \u201c[Multiple \u2014 see File Count]\u201d for Row #\u00a0s "
  "27\u201332 and Row #\u00a034, so no file-level manifest exists in the exhibit; Report Metadata B13 states "
  "that the full audit log contains 12,847 events for the review period and that only 50 were selected; "
  "Complaint \u00b6 49 alleges on information and belief that the transfer encompassed all five trade-secret "
  "categories.",
  "Without a manifest, Exhibit F cannot establish which files moved, and therefore cannot establish that "
  "any trade secret or any copyrighted source file moved. Framing the precise request now shapes the first "

  "Exhibit F pairs a UTC \u201cTimestamp (UTC)\u201d column with an \u201cEvent Time (CT)\u201d column offset by "

  "\u00b6\u00b6 54, 119 and 120 contest it.",

# =====================================================================
# VI. LEGAL LEAD
# =====================================================================
h(1, "VI.  Witness Category 3 \u2014 Meridian's Legal Lead")

para("Meridian's legal lead \u2014 identified in our materials as Jordan Kessler, VP of Legal, who was copied "
     "on outside counsel's April 5, 2024 response \u2014 is interviewed for a different purpose than the other "
     "two categories. This witness is the custodian of the company's factual record about how the dispute "
     "was received, routed, preserved and responded to, and the person best positioned to map Meridian's "
     "policies, agreements and systems. That value comes with the sharpest privilege constraints in this "
     "round: the same conversation that yields discoverable facts about dates, custodians, policies and "
     "systems will run continuously along the boundary of attorney\u2013client communications and work "
     "product, and the interviewer must police that boundary in real time rather than sort it out later.")

h(2, "A.  Discoverable Factual Events, Records and Systems")

q("L-1", "Describe the intake of SkyVault's March 12, 2024 letter \u2014 when it arrived, in what form, who "
         "received it, how it was routed internally, and what was calendared as a result.",
  "Complaint \u00b6 61 (letter dated March 12, 2024, sent by Callister, Voss & Greenbaum LLP to CEO Priya "
  "Chandrasekaran at Meridian's Austin headquarters, identifying the three patents-in-suit and making "
  "three demands) and the April 5, 2024 letter (acknowledging receipt and responding within 24 days). The "
  "March 12, 2024 letter is not in our file.",
  "Receipt and routing are objective events, not privileged communications, and they fix the notice date "

q("L-2", "Identify the date any litigation hold issued, the custodians it reached, the systems and date "

  "notice no later than March 2024.",
  "The existence, date, distribution and scope of a hold are ordinarily discoverable even where the "
  "notice's text is withheld, and they are the first thing an opponent probes on a spoliation theory. Ask "
  "for the operative facts; do not ask the witness to recite counsel's drafting deliberations."),

q("L-3", "What preservation or collection steps, if any, were taken in 2018 at Meridian's formation, and "

  "that period survives \u2014 the earliest and most probative window for the independent-development "

  "processes designed to safeguard against the unauthorized use of third-party intellectual property.\u201d",
  "A representation has already been made in writing to opposing counsel. The underlying policies are "
  "ordinary business records, not privileged, and either substantiate the statement or reveal an exposure "
  "the partner must know about immediately."),

q("L-6", "What does Meridian require of employees on intellectual property \u2014 assignment agreements, "
         "prior-invention disclosures, confidentiality undertakings \u2014 and does a complete set exist for "
         "Dr. Holt and for the early engineering hires?",
  "ECIAA \u00a7\u00a7 5.1\u20135.4 illustrate the structure SkyVault used, including the Exhibit A "

  "unpleaded non-solicitation provision."),

q("L-7", "Who approves the introduction of open-source or third-party components, is approval logged, and "
         "do the approval records go back to 2018?",
  "White paper \u00a7 4.2 and \u00a7 7.2 (reliance on publicly available implementations including DroneNav) "
  "and Reference 2; the April 5, 2024 letter's compliance representation.",
  "Bridges the technical and legal records: an approval log converts the white paper's narrative "
  "attribution into a documented, auditable decision trail."),

q("L-8", "Identify the fact and timing of any intellectual-property diligence conducted for the March 2023 "
         "Series B round, who conducted it, what categories of materials were furnished, and what "
         "confidentiality or common-interest agreements govern those materials.",
  "Complaint \u00b6 12 (a $35 million Series B round led by Ridgepoint Ventures in March 2023, and 2023 "
  "revenue of approximately $19.4 million, both pleaded on information and belief in part).",
  "Diligence files often contain the earliest contemporaneous written statements about technology "
  "provenance, made long before any dispute. Disclosure to investors also raises waiver questions that "
  "must be scoped before anything is produced or relied upon."),

q("L-9", "Identify every person with factual involvement in responding to the SkyVault allegations, "
         "separating those who acted at counsel's direction from those who did not.",
  "The April 5, 2024 letter (signed by Laura Brackwell of Brackwell & Haines LLP, copied to Jordan "
  "Kessler, VP of Legal) and Complaint \u00b6 62 (describing the response as coming from Meridian's outside "

  "Sets the custodian list and draws the privilege perimeter before substantive questioning begins. People "

q("L-10", "What communications has Meridian had with Dr. Holt regarding his SkyVault obligations \u2014 at "
          "hiring, at any point thereafter, and since March 2024?",
  "Complaint \u00b6 130 alleges that \u201cMeridian was aware of Holt's obligations under the ECIAA and induced, "
  "participated in, and benefited from Holt's breach\u201d; ECIAA \u00a7\u00a7 3.1, 3.5 and 5.2 define the "
  "obligations in question; Complaint \u00b6 53 places Holt's arrival at Meridian in April 2018.",

  "the subject are largely non-privileged and may be the best evidence either way; post-March-2024 "
  "communications will mostly be privileged and should be logged rather than explored."),

q("L-11", "Was Meridian ever given a copy of the ECIAA, and if so, when, by whom, and what was done with "

q("L-12", "Has any insurance policy been noticed, and does Meridian owe indemnities to PathForge customers "

  "for Relief (injunctive relief against further making, using and selling, plus damages of no less than "

h(2, "B.  Matters Presumptively Protected \u2014 Handling Protocol")

para("The following topics should be raised only to establish the threshold facts identified, and then "
     "stopped. Where the witness begins to disclose the substance of legal advice, counsel's requests, or "
     "counsel's mental impressions, the interviewer should note the topic for the privilege log and move "
     "on. The distinction to hold in mind is between the occurrence of an event (generally discoverable) "
     "and the content of a privileged communication about it (generally not).", after=8)

q("L-13", "Has Meridian obtained any written opinion of counsel concerning the '561, '227 or '889 Patents, "
          "and if so, on what dates? Please do not describe its content.",

  "apparent attempt to design around \u2026 or obtain a license\u201d; the April 5, 2024 letter denies "
  "infringement and reserves invalidity and unenforceability defenses.",
  "The existence and date of an opinion are threshold facts the partner needs in order to evaluate a "
  "possible advice-of-counsel defense. Electing that defense would waive privilege over the subject "
  "matter, so the content must not be explored in this interview and the election is the partner's "

q("L-14", "Has Meridian conducted or commissioned any technical comparison of PathForge against AeroCore, "
          "the patents-in-suit, or the deposited copyright material \u2014 and if so, when, by whom, and at "

  "Complaint \u00b6\u00b6 116\u2013119 (the copyright registration TX 9-142-338 covering AeroCore Firmware Suite "

  "\u00b6 67; the April 5, 2024 letter states that SkyVault's letter supplied no claim-by-claim analysis and "
  "that Meridian is \u201caware of none.\u201d",
  "Distinguishes protected litigation analysis from any ordinary-course engineering comparison, which may "
  "not be protected at all. Establish which category any such work falls into before it is described."),

q("L-15", "Who supplied the factual predicates for the independent-development statement in the April 5, "
          "2024 letter, and what documents were reviewed \u2014 identifying people and documents only, not "
          "counsel's analysis of them?",
  "The April 5, 2024 letter: \u201cMeridian independently developed its PathForge platform through the "
  "efforts of its engineering teams\u201d, together with its reservation of an independent-development "
  "defense.",
  "Meridian has asserted independent development in writing. The identity of the people and documents "
  "behind that assertion is the roadmap for corroborating it; the reasoning behind it is protected. The "
  "phrasing of the question is what keeps the two apart."),

q("L-16", "Has the question of separate counsel for Dr. Holt been evaluated, and does leadership understand "
          "that he faces potential individual exposure?",
  "Complaint Count VII (\u00b6\u00b6 126\u2013132) pleads breach of the ECIAA by Holt while seeking to hold "
  "Meridian liable for it, and Counts IV and V (\u00b6\u00b6 94, 107) allege that Holt personally "
  "misappropriated the trade secrets; ECIAA \u00a7\u00a7 8.1\u20138.3 provide for injunctive relief and "
  "fee-shifting against the employee; the April 5, 2024 letter responds on behalf of \u201cMeridian and its "
  "officers and directors.\u201d",
  "This must be resolved before the Holt interview. Holt is both Meridian's CTO and the individual whose "
  "conduct is the subject of the claims; a conflict surfacing after his interview could compromise the "
  "privilege over it and the usability of everything he says. Upjohn warnings are necessary but may not be "
  "sufficient."),

q("L-17", "Has the request that SkyVault not contact Meridian's officers and employees been communicated "
          "internally, and what protocol applies to former employees, who are outside that request?",
  "The April 5, 2024 letter (requesting that SkyVault and its counsel refrain from contacting Meridian's "
  "officers and employees directly and directing all correspondence to Brackwell & Haines LLP).",
  "Former employees are ordinarily reachable by opposing counsel. Knowing who they are, and whether any "
  "has already been approached, is both a witness-protection and an information-security question."),

q("L-18", "Did any without-prejudice discussions in fact occur following the April 2024 exchange, and if "
          "so, when, with whom, and under what confidentiality terms?",
  "The April 5, 2024 letter (offering to \u201carrange a call or meeting at a mutually convenient time\u201d, "
  "made \u201cwithout prejudice\u201d and \u201csubject to applicable rules governing settlement "
  "communications\u201d); Complaint \u00b6 62 characterizes the response as a categorical refusal to comply "
  "with any demand.",
  "Whether a settlement track ever opened is a fact the partner needs for posture and for scheduling. The "
  "content of any such discussion is separately protected and should not be explored here."),

# =====================================================================
# VII. SEQUENCING
# =====================================================================
h(1, "VII.  Recommended Sequencing")

para("We recommend interviewing Meridian's legal lead first, the technical team second, and Dr. Holt last, "
     "for reasons that are practical rather than formal. The legal lead should go first because that "
     "interview is the only one that can set the privilege perimeter before anyone generates a witness "
     "statement: it confirms that a litigation hold is in place and that auto-deletion has been suspended "
     "(L-2, L-4, T-20), produces the custodian and systems map the other two interviews depend on (L-9), "
     "and \u2014 most importantly \u2014 forces resolution of the separate-counsel question for Dr. Holt (L-16) "
     "before he sits, since a conflict surfacing afterward could compromise the privilege over his "
     "interview and the usability of everything he says. The technical team should go second because it is "
     "the records-bearing group: its answers convert assertions into artifacts \u2014 repository history and "
     "earliest commits (T-4, T-5), dependency manifests and the DroneNav question (T-6), a defensible "
     "search for the three named AeroCore file names and for SkyVault-origin strings (T-7, T-15), the "
     "search for the four claim-chart component names absent from the white paper we hold (T-12), and a "
     "practitioner's reading of the 4,700-file record and its time-zone and overlap problems (T-16, T-17, "
     "T-19). Those results are precisely the material against which Dr. Holt's recollection can be tested. "
     "He goes last because he is the only witness whose knowledge spans all six lead families and the only "
     "one who is personally the subject of the central allegations; his account should be taken against a "
     "documentary record already assembled rather than be allowed to define what we then go looking for, "
     "and the questions that matter most \u2014 the evening of February 8\u20139, 2018 (H-5), the eight-week "
     "pre-incorporation window (H-18), the eight distinct states of DroneNav use and non-use (H-37), and "
     "whether any SkyVault material ever reached Meridian (H-28) \u2014 can only be asked open-endedly once, "
     "and are worth far more when we can immediately test the answers. This order is not the only "
     "defensible one, and two contingencies would displace it: if the legal lead's interview reveals that "
     "no hold issued or that a relevant system is still deleting data, preservation triage takes priority "
     "over every scheduled interview; and if Dr. Holt retains separate counsel, we should take a limited, "
     "conflict-cleared preliminary session with him covering only device custody and preservation (H-6, "
     "H-11), and defer the substantive families until his counsel is in place.")

blocks.text:
This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:

The user (writing in Chinese) assigned a single deliverable task in a Linux container with working directory `/app`. Five client/case materials sit in `/app/data/input_files/` and **must not be modified in place**.

   **Scenario/product boundary:** Meridian Dynamics, Inc. has engaged IP litigation counsel to conduct a privileged internal fact investigation into SkyVault Technologies LLC's allegations. Before any testimony preparation, the managing partner needs an interview plan stating what to ask each witness category, why each question matters, and which produced document is the factual lead. The deliverable is an **interview-design memorandum** — *not* completed testimony, a pleading, an infringement comparison chart, a settlement letter, or a merits/win opinion.

   **The seven explicit task requirements:**
   1. Produce an **all-English witness-interview outline memorandum** divided into three witness categories: **Dr. Marcus Holt**, the **Meridian technical team**, and **Meridian's legal lead**. Each gets its own section, opening with **two to three complete sentences** explaining that witness's role in this interview round, followed by questions that can actually be asked orally.
   2. Every question must carry a `Source:` and an `Evidentiary purpose:` annotation. Cite the file name and, where available, pinpoint to paragraph, section, exhibit, worksheet, `Row #`, worksheet row number, event date/time zone, event type, file name, or record ID. When a question relies on multiple materials, explain which source supports which proposition — do not merely stack file names.
   3. Use **only the five listed materials** as in-package factual sources. Convert missing personnel files, code repositories, development records, preservation records, internal communications, compliance materials, complete forensic data, and technical comparisons into **interview-confirmation or document-collection questions** — never treat them as established facts. **The March 12, 2024 letter itself was not provided; nothing may be attributed to it beyond what Complaint ¶ 61 and the April 5, 2024 response letter record.**
   4. Assess each material's actual evidentiary reach: the Complaint is SkyVault's allegation; Meridian's response-letter denials, independent-development and compliance statements are a party position; the white paper is a 2022 public technical/marketing statement; the ECIAA is contract plus prior-invention disclosure; Exhibit F is SkyVault's side's selected event extract for the `mholt` account. **Do not elevate the mere existence of any material into established fact of misuse, infringement, independent development, complete preservation, final authorization, or technical provenance.**
   5. Questions must run through at least **six lead families**: Holt's tenure and access history; Holt's disclosed prior work; PathForge's development origin; the white paper's title and authorship information; DroneNav and other public sources; the pre-suit correspondence chain. PathForge-provenance questioning must be granular enough to separate different technical modules, contributors, code/dependencies, testing, and release records; public-source questioning must distinguish **awareness, citation, evaluation, cloning, dependency introduction, modification, use, and non-use**.
   6. Use **open-ended phrasing** where a fact needs witness confirmation. Legal-team questions must separate discoverable factual events from communications, legal opinions, and attorney mental impressions potentially protected by **attorney-client privilege or work-product protection**.
   7. Close with a **short recommendation paragraph** naming the suggested first, second, and last interview categories and explaining how that order uses early interviews and collection results to test later witnesses' accounts. No single correct order is presumed; the rationale must be actionable and grounded in privilege scope, available records, witness knowledge, and cross-verification value.

   **Deliverable:** submit only `/app/output/result.docx` — non-empty, readable, professional legal-memorandum format, entirely in English. When calling finish, report only `/app/output/result.docx`. Do not answer only in conversation; do not submit scripts, caches, intermediate requests, logs, or historical versions.

   **Environment constraint carried in the system prompt:** "Do not use the Agent tool, workflows, or deep-research unless the user, a CLAUDE.md file, or a skill asks for it." Git/PR attribution lines were supplied but are inapplicable (not a git repository).

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Python `python-docx` (available) for reading .docx and authoring the output memorandum; `openpyxl` (available) for reading the .xlsx forensic log.
   - Legal-memorandum drafting: privileged & confidential / attorney work-product captioning, witness-category sections, per-question `Source:` / `Evidentiary purpose:` annotation, document-collection requests, interview sequencing rationale.
   - Substantive IP litigation concepts: patent infringement and willfulness (35 U.S.C. §§ 271, 284, 285), DTSA (18 U.S.C. § 1836 et seq.), TUTSA (Tex. Civ. Prac. & Rem. Code § 134A.001 et seq.), copyright infringement (17 U.S.C. § 501; work made for hire under § 201(b)), breach of contract, unjust enrichment, Texas common-law unfair competition.
   - Defense themes to be tested (not asserted): independent development, prior art / public-source provenance, general skills and knowledge, prior-inventions carve-out, discovery rule and statute of limitations, forum/venue clause, chain of custody, log completeness and selection bias, UTC vs. Central Time date attribution.
   - Privilege architecture: discoverable facts (existence, timing, participants, custodians, collection steps) vs. protected attorney communications, opinions and mental impressions; advice-of-counsel waiver and subject-matter waiver risk on willfulness.
   - Forensic-log concepts: Confluence audit logs, Endpoint Security Agent events, Active Directory authentication, USB device connection registry, DLP thresholds, litigation hold, forensic imaging, SHA-256 hash verification.

3. Files and Code Sections:

   - **`/app/data/input_files/skyvault-complaint.docx`** (extracted to `/tmp/ext/skyvault-complaint.txt`, 259 lines) — SkyVault's allegations; the backbone of most leads.
     - Caption: *SkyVault Technologies LLC v. Meridian Dynamics, Inc.*, No. 2:24-cv-00817-JRG, E.D. Tex. Marshall Division; filed **October 2, 2024**; Callister, Voss & Greenbaum LLP (Theresa N. Voss).
     - ¶¶ 4–8 SkyVault: DE LLC formed Jan 8, 2016; Plano, TX; founder Dr. Rajan Mehta; 14 patents; FY2023 revenue ~$8.2M; ~34 employees.
     - ¶¶ 9–12 Meridian: DE corp formed **April 11, 2018**; Austin, TX; co-founders CEO **Priya Chandrasekaran** and CTO **Dr. Marcus Holt**; ~112 employees; March 2023 $35M Series B led by Ridgepoint Ventures; FY2023 revenue ~$19.4M; >$50M cumulative PathForge revenue since the **September 2020** launch.
     - ¶ 28 **'561 Patent** 10,234,561, "System and Method for Real-Time Obstacle Avoidance in UAVs Using Multi-Sensor Fusion," filed **March 14, 2017**, issued Sept 18, 2018, 22 claims (3 indep./19 dep.), inventor Mehta, Exhibit A.
     - ¶ 29 **'227 Patent** 10,891,227, "Adaptive Flight Path Optimization Algorithm for GPS-Denied Environments," filed **November 9, 2018**, issued Jan 14, 2020, 17 claims (2/15), inventors Mehta and Dr. Anita Venkatesh, Exhibit B.
     - ¶ 30 **'889 Patent** 11,402,889, "Low-Latency Communication Protocol for Drone Swarm Coordination," filed **June 22, 2020**, issued Aug 2, 2022, 28 claims (4/24), inventors Mehta, Venkatesh, Kevin Larsson, Exhibit C.
     - ¶ 33 / ¶ 116 / ¶ 118 AeroCore source files `navfusion.c`, `pathoptengine.h`, `swarm_proto.cpp`.
     - ¶ 35 / ¶ 117 Copyright Reg. **TX 9-142-338**, issued April 3, 2023, "AeroCore Firmware Suite v2.0," Exhibit D.
     - ¶ 38 / ¶ 91 / ¶ 105 trade secrets **TS-1** sensor fusion algorithms; **TS-2** flight path optimization models; **TS-3** customer lists and pricing strategies; **TS-4** drone swarm communication protocols; **TS-5** LiDAR hardware integration specifications.
     - ¶¶ 40, 93, 106 "reasonable security measures" — password-protected systems, access limited to authorized personnel.
     - ¶ 42 Holt PhD Robotics, Georgia Tech, 2015; doctoral research on autonomous navigation and multi-sensor data integration.
     - ¶ 43 hired **June 13, 2016**; resignation effective **February 16, 2018**.
     - ¶ 44 alleged broad access to AeroCore, TS-1, TS-2, TS-4, TS-5, and TS-3 via customer demos/proposals.
     - ¶¶ 45–46 ECIAA dated June 13, 2016 (Exhibit E); summarizes § 3 (trade secrets perpetual; other CI three years), § 5, § 7.
     - ¶¶ 48–52 alleged Feb 9, 2018 download of ~4,700 Confluence files to a "personal USB storage device"; flagged by IT admin Feb 12, 2018; Exhibit F identified as the Hargrove Forensics Group log; no return of device and no destruction certification.
     - ¶¶ 53–55 co-founded Meridian April 11, 2018 as CTO; "on information and belief" used the files to build PathForge and disclosed trade secrets to Meridian engineers.
     - ¶ 57 July 2022 white paper "PathForge: Next-Generation Autonomous Navigation," authored by "**Dr. Marcus Holt and the Meridian engineering team**," Exhibit G.
     - ¶ 61 **March 12, 2024 cease-and-desist** to Chandrasekaran identifying the three patents and demanding (i) cessation, (ii) **$15 million** in licensing fees, (iii) a full forensic audit of Meridian's source code repositories.
     - ¶ 62 April 5, 2024 Brackwell & Haines response refusing all demands.

The memorandum is complete: **`/app/output/result.docx`** (68.6 KB, 294 paragraphs, 2 tables, all English).

- **Caption + TO/FROM/DATE/RE block** — privileged and confidential / attorney work product.
